title: Burst Main Water Pipeline Flooding Residential Society
description: Major 18-inch water main has burst outside Sunshine Apartments. Hundreds of liters of potable water are gushing onto the road every minute, causing basement waterlogging and cutting drinking supply to 400 flats.

aiAnalysis.severityAssessment: Critical infrastructure failure leading to massive resource loss and property flooding.
aiAnalysis.suggestedAction: Immediately isolate feeder valve V-104 and dispatch welding/pipe replacement team.
aiAnalysis.summary: High volume potable water line rupture affecting 400+ residences.
aiAnalysis.routingRationale: Matched Water Supply & Sewerage from 'pipeline burst', 'drinking water supply', 'flooding'.

timeline.title: Emergency AI Triage
timeline.description: Critical urgency detected. Feeder valve isolation alert triggered automatically.

timeline.title: Valve Shut & Trenching Complete
timeline.description: Sluice valve closed. Damaged cast-iron collar replaced with heavy-duty ductile iron clamp.

timeline.title: Pipe Replaced & Supply Restored

feedback.comment: Superb and fast resolution by the water board team! Repaired in under 8 hours.

resolutionNotes: Replaced 3-meter section of 18-inch DI pipe. Verified zero leakage under 6 bar operational pressure.
